title: What The Garden Knows — EN/ES/IT (Wilma McIvor)
style: folk country acoustic guitar warm female vocal 100bpm brushed drums gentle storytelling intimate garden Spanish Italian language learning wisdom Perth
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The garden knows when you haven't been paying attention
It shows you in the weeds without a word of intervention
It knows the summer's coming three weeks before you do
The garden's been preparing while you were doing something through

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
El jardín sabe cuándo no has estado presente
[The garden knows when you haven't been present]
Te lo muestra con malezas crecidas lentamente
[It shows you with weeds grown slowly]
Conoce el verano tres semanas antes que tú
[It knows summer three weeks before you do]
El jardín prepara mientras tú sigues tu virtud
[The garden prepares while you follow your path]

[Chorus — English]
What does the garden know that I don't know?
It knows that things take time and time is how things grow
What does the garden know in the quiet of the dawn?
It knows that everything you planted will keep coming back with the morn
The gardens still growing

[Bridge — Italian, with English translation]
Il giardino sa quando non ci sei stata
[The garden knows when you haven't been there]
Ti mostra le erbacce come una verità donata
[It shows you the weeds like a truth given as a gift]
Conosce l'estate tre settimane prima di te
[It knows summer three weeks before you]
Il giardino sa sempre quello che stai cercando te
[The garden always knows what you are looking for]

[Outro — All three languages]
What the garden knows… Lo que sabe el jardín… Quello che sa il giardino
The roots go deeper — Las raíces van más profundo — Le radici vanno più in profondo
The gardens still growing
